start_gcode: M118 X60.00 Y60.00 Z140.00 T0 ; Define bounding box based on our prime line
M140 S{bed_temp} T0 ; Heated bed setting
M104 S{nozzle_temp} T0 ; Set nozzle temp
M104 S0 T1 ; Force off unused second extruder
M132 X Y Z A B ; Recall FlashForge home offsets
G1 Z50.000 F420 ; Lower bed to safe distance
G161 X Y F3300 ; Home X and Y to physical endstops
M6 T0 ; FlashForge specific: Wait for nozzle to reach temp
M651 S255 ; Turn on chassis cooling fan
G1 X{prime_x_start} Y{prime_y_start} F4800 ; Move to prime position
G1 Z0.3 F1500 ; Lower to bed
G1 X{prime_x_end} Y{prime_y_end} E{prime_extrusion} F{prime_speed} ; Prime line
end_gcode: M104 S0 T0 ; Turn off nozzle heater
G162 Z F1800 ; FlashForge specific: Drop bed all the way down
G28 X Y ; Home X and Y
M132 X Y A B ; Recall offsets
